name: How does AKN Design Group approach drywall installation in a home addition project?

mainEntity.name: How does AKN Design Group approach drywall installation in a home addition project?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a home addition, AKN Design Group integrates drywall installation as a critical step within our managed design-build process. This includes careful planning for material selection, ensuring proper insulation, and coordinating with electrical and plumbing rough-ins before installation. Our approach guarantees that new drywall seamlessly blends with existing structures and prepares the space for high-end finishes, enhancing functionality and beauty while maintaining aesthetic consistency throughout your expanded home.
acceptedAnswer.description: AKN Design Group integrates drywall installation in home additions as a critical part of the design-build process, ensuring seamless blending with existing structures and preparing for high-end finishes.
